t: A low-cost chip that combines a LoRa long-range radio with a small processor.
steps: Buy the Ai-Thinker Ra-08H-KIT from DigiKey for US or European bands, or the Ra-08-KIT for the 470 MHz Chinese band.
Attach the antenna before you power the board.
Connect the kit over micro USB and open a serial terminal to try the AT commands.
Install the GNU Arm Embedded toolchain on Linux or Windows.
Download the ASR asr_lora_6601 SDK from GitHub.
Build a sample project and put the board in download mode by holding SW3 and pressing reset.
Flash the program with the Python loader from the SDK.
meta: Open Board. From $7.52. A few stores.
